status_definitions.DRAFT: Defined in registry but not approved for public print/use.
status_definitions.READY_FOR_GENERATION: Target URL and copy are approved; QR image can be generated.
status_definitions.GENERATED: QR image file has been generated but not yet approved for print.
status_definitions.ACTIVE: Approved for public placement and live use.
status_definitions.RETIRED: No longer used for new placements; preserve record for audit.
